item.title: Audrey McCabe (Nee Blackburn)
item.description: Audrey passed away peacefully with Bernadine watching over her on Monday, February 16, 2026. There will be a Celebration of Life will be held on Friday, March 6, 2026 at 11a.m. at Mount Calvary Lutheran Church, 18 Selkirk Blvd, Red Deer, AB T4N 0G2. Her arrangements have been entrusted with Funeral Director Amber Visser-Sieben and Eventide Funeral Home.
